delivery.meaning: 仅表示优化智能体已提交并通过必需文件检查，不代表任何光学指标达标。

agent_verdict.reason: Selected candidate-003, best of the seed_198 all-spherical 6-element Double Gauss line: physically feasible (min vertex spacing 2.65 mm, 0 aspheres, all distortion rays valid) and close to contract but not exact - ray-traced EFL 51.26 mm (+2.5%), sensor-implied FOV 45.97 deg (-2.2%), working F/2.833 (+1.2%). Since the contract states these as exact with no tolerance, compliance cannot be certified (all three marked unknown_tolerance). Image quality is only modest (RMS spot 44/55/72 um center/mid/edge, center geometric MTF50 7.4 cy/mm, edge distortion -4.2%), and edge-ray validity fractions are not reported, so edge performance stays unconfirmed. Reported as a weak-but-fully-evidenced outcome, not a validated pass nor a demonstrated constraint violation.
agent_verdict.stop_reason: Fine-tune decelerated across three equal chunks (loss_rms 0.0655->0.0520->0.0467; edge RMS spot 120->82->72 um; center spot 57->47->44 um) while the ~+2.5% EFL offset and +/-1.2% F/# wander stayed stable, and the exported artifact itself records the realized 51.3 mm EFL - i.e. the residual is set at the objective/parametrization level, not by this starting basin, so another seed or more iterations would not introduce a decision-changing result. Optimization stops with the best evidenced artifact.

note: Raw tool output is stored in agents/, events/, engines/, and verification/; it is referenced rather than embedded here.
